expected.name: Albert Constant Belhomme
expected.description: Albert Constant Belhomme was a Belgian-born U.S. Army sergeant who had emigrated to the United States as a teenager. Captured during the Korean War, he became one of 21 American servicemen who declined repatriation and crossed into China on February 24, 1954. He worked in a Jinan paper factory and lived in China for about ten years before returning to Antwerp, Belgium.
